taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-08, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-08, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station H-08**

Station H-08 presents a 6-layer geoelectric profile. Resistivity decreases from the surface layer (218.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, 18.02 m thick) through Layer 2 (105.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, 1.05 m thick) to a conductive target in Layer 3 (60.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, depth 19.07–20.11 m). Beneath this zone, resistive basement conditions emerge with Layer 4 (317.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$), Layer 5 (1743.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$), and Layer 6 (2231.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$).

Evaluating consecutive three-layer triplets (218.1 > 105.0 > 60.0 $\rightarrow$ Q; 105.0 > 60.0 < 317.3 $\rightarrow$ H; 60.0 < 317.3 < 1743.2 $\rightarrow$ A; 317.3 < 1743.2 < 2231.3 $\rightarrow$ A) defines a 4-letter **QHAA** curve. The archived classification of "QHA-type" is flagged as an error, as a 6-layer model requires four curve-type designators.

{"curve_type_stated": "QHA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
